evidence.reason: render_units collects every crq-* template recursively and writes each to output/source.name without checking basename uniqueness. If two source paths share a basename, the later atomic_bytes call overwrites the earlier unit and paths contains duplicate entries, so prepare can verify the same final file twice while silently dropping a distinct unit. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the flat output write, not a new requirement.
